create_sde_drag_pipeline: create a Stable Diffusion pipeline for image drag-and-drop editing using stochastic differential equations
train_lora_for_drag: train LoRA adapters on the UNet to preserve image consistency during drag editing
drag_edit_image: drag and edit regions of an image by specifying source and target points with a prompt and mask
copy_and_paste_latent: copy and paste latent features between source and target regions in the diffusion latent space
run_backward_sde_sampling: run backward SDE sampling to reconstruct the edited image while preserving unmasked regions
